from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    top,bot=g[0],g[-1]
    tcol=Counter(v for v in top if v!=bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bcol=Counter(v for v in bot if v!=bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    tcols=[j for j,v in enumerate(top) if v==tcol]
    bcols=[j for j,v in enumerate(bot) if v==bcol]
    seeds=[(i,j) for i in range(1,H-1) for j in range(W) if g[i][j] not in (bg,tcol,bcol)]
    scol=Counter(g[i][j] for i,j in seeds).most_common(1)[0][0]
    k=len(seeds); mr=min(i for i,j in seeds)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(1,H-1):
        for j in tcols[-k:]: out[i][j]=scol
    for i in range(mr,H-1):
        for j in bcols[-k:]: out[i][j]=scol
    for i,j in seeds: out[i][j]=4
    return out
